s.g: (computer graphics, attributive) The axes of a two-dimensional texture, as opposed to those (X, Y, Z) of the three-dimensional model to which it is applied.
s.x: UV mapping; UV coordinates; UV texturing

uv.f: (sometimes leetspeak) Eye dialect spelling of of.

s.g: (anatomy) The middle of the three concentric layers that make up the eye; it is pigmented and vascular, and comprises the choroid, the ciliary body, and the iris.
Of or pertaining to the uvea
(anatomy) the slight elevation in the mucous membrane immediately behind the internal urethral orifice of the urinary bladder, caused by the middle lobe of the prostate
(music) an object so suspended inside a bell that it may hit the bell and cause it to ring; a clapper

uvula.f: (anatomy) Ellipsis of palatine uvula, the fleshy appendage that hangs from the back of the soft palate, that closes the nasopharynx during swallowing.

s.g: (anatomy) Of or relating to the uvula.
(phonetics) Of a sound, articulated with the uvula (the fleshy appendage that hangs from the back of the soft palate).
(phonetics) A sound articulated with the uvula.
(surgery) A surgical procedure used to remove tissue in the throat in order to widen the airway of the patient, typically carried out as treatment for sleep apnea.
